selection_rules.stock: Choose the no-floor-stand or floor-stand 01 lower LM piece; 02–04 are shared. Then choose exactly one attachment set: A shoulders or B1 wings.
selection_rules.slim: Choose the no-floor-stand or floor-stand 01 lower LM piece; 02–04 are shared. Then choose exactly one attachment set: A shoulders or B1 wings.
selection_rules.obiwan: Choose either the individual core files (the no-floor-stand or floor-stand 01, plus 02–04) or the 01+02+03+04 combo plate for that same stand state; never mix stand states or print both forms. Then choose Ac or Ae and exactly one wing split: split3 (3 pieces per side) or split2 (2 pieces per side). For a split2 wing set, choose either its four individual wing projects or its combo plate; never both.
